subject.title: [Feature]: Allow agents to resolve Slack channel IDs to names via channel-info/channel-list

question: Should Slack's existing `channelInfo` capability authorize targeted channel lookup only, or also workspace-wide conversation discovery?
rationale: Targeted metadata lookup and channel listing differ materially in exposure breadth, credentials, pagination, and authorization expectations, and current main does not define the intended contract.

options.title: Targeted Lookup First
options.body: Add `channel-info` under the existing capability and defer workspace-wide listing until its discovery policy is approved.

options.title: Separate Listing Capability
options.body: Add both actions but require an independent opt-in and explicit conversation-type policy for `channel-list`.

options.title: Combined Capability
options.body: Define the existing `channelInfo` setting as authorizing both targeted lookup and paginated listing.

recommendation.title: Targeted Lookup First
recommendation.body: Add `channel-info` under the existing capability and defer workspace-wide listing until its discovery policy is approved.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent broad Slack parity work and review of the closest authorization-boundary change provide the strongest available product-routing signal.
